Interview FAQs

F FAQs — Interview Questions

36 current-era interview FAQs — Claude, LLMs, prompt engineering, ethics aur AI careers par. Har sawal par click karke jawab kholein.

01Claude kya hai aur ye ChatGPT se kaise alag hai?
Claude Anthropic ka AI assistant hai, jo large language model par bana hai. ChatGPT ke mukable iski pehchan: Constitutional AI (values-based training), lamba context window, aur Artifacts/Projects jaise features. Dono ke beech choice aapke use case par depend karti hai - writing aur long documents ke liye Claude aksar prefer kiya jata hai, jabki ChatGPT ka ecosystem aur plugins zyada broad hain. Koi bhi tool choose karne se pehle apne kaam ke liye dono ko try karke compare karein.
02LLM (Large Language Model) ka matlab kya hai?
LLM ek aisa AI model hai jo bahut bade text data par train kiya gaya hota hai aur language ke patterns seekhta hai. Ye words ko predict karta hai - samajhta nahi hai, lekin patterns itne acche seekhta hai ki uske outputs intelligent lagte hain. Claude ek LLM hai jo Transformer architecture par bana hai. LLM ke baare me interview me ye samajhna zaroori hai: training, tokens, context window aur hallucination jaise concepts isse judte hain.
03Tokens kya hote hain aur ye kyun matter karte hain?
Tokens text ki basic units hain jinme Claude language process karta hai - na exactly words, na exactly letters. English me lagbhag 4 characters = 1 token hota hai; 'Hello' = 1 token hai. Tokens isliye matter karte hain: (1) context window tokens me measure hota hai, (2) API pricing tokens par hoti hai, (3) lambe prompts zyada tokens khate hain. Apne prompt ki length ka andaza lagane ke liye is SPA ka Token Estimator lab try karein.
04Context window kya hai aur iski limit kya hoti hai?
Context window maximum text hai jo Claude ek conversation turn me process kar sakta hai, input aur output dono samet. Jab conversation lambi hoti hai to purana context window se bahar ho jata hai aur Claude use bhool jata hai. Isse handle karne ke liye: important information ko summarize karke nayi conversation me le jayein, checkpoints banayein, aur Projects me context store karein. Context window ki exact size model aur plan ke hisaab se badalti rehti hai.
05Hallucination kya hai aur isse kaise bachein?
Hallucination tab hoti hai jab AI aisi information generate karta hai jo plausible lagti hai lekin actually false hoti hai - jaise galat dates, fake citations ya non-existent statistics. Isse bachne ke liye: (1) medical, legal, financial, dates aur statistics hamesha verify karein, (2) sources maangein aur unhe check karein, (3) specific details ke liye Claude par blind trust na karein, (4) Three-Source Rule use karein. Hallucination LLM ki fundamental limitation hai, bug nahi.
06Claude ka knowledge cutoff kya hai aur iska kya matlab hai?
Knowledge cutoff wo date hai jiske baad ki events ke baare me Claude ko training ke time pata nahi hota. Is kitab ke time par cutoff January 2025 tha. Iska matlab: current events, recent product launches ya naye research ke baare me Claude galat ya outdated information de sakta hai. Aise topics par hamesha fresh sources se verify karein aur Claude ko relevant documents upload karke context dein.
07Prompt engineering kya hai aur ek achha prompt kaise likhein?
Prompt engineering inputs craft karne ki kala aur science hai jo optimal outputs deti hai. Ek achhe prompt ke chaar ingredients hote hain: Context (background), Specific request (kya chahiye), Constraints (limitations), aur Format (output kaisa chahiye). Example: 'Main 10 logon ke liye team meeting plan kar raha hoon. Q4 goals discuss karne ke liye agenda banao. 1 ghante se kam rakho. Allocated minutes ke saath bulleted timeline ki tarah format karo.' Is SPA ka Prompt Anatomy Builder lab is structure ko live practice karwata hai.
08Few-shot prompting kya hai aur ye kab use karein?
Few-shot prompting me aap Claude ko 2-3 examples dete hain taaki wo pattern samajh le, phir wo usi pattern me naya output banata hai. Ye tab best hai jab aapko specific style, format ya tone chahiye jo describe karna mushkil ho - jaise product descriptions, email style ya code style. Zero-shot (koi example nahi) simple tasks ke liye kaafi hai; one-shot (ek example) medium tasks ke liye; few-shot complex style-matching ke liye.
09Chain-of-thought prompting kya hai?
Chain-of-thought prompting me aap Claude se kehte hain ki wo step-by-step soche, final answer se pehle reasoning dikhaye. Example: 'Har step ko conduct karne se pehle think through karo.' Ye complex problems, maths, logic aur multi-step analysis me accuracy badhata hai. Recursive chain of thought iska advanced version hai - har level par assumptions ko bhi question kiya jata hai. Lekin 2-3 levels ke baad diminishing returns aate hain.
10Role-playing prompt kya hai aur ye kaise kaam karta hai?
Role-playing prompt me aap Claude ko ek specific expert role me daalte hain: 'Ek experienced grant writer ki tarah act karo.' Isse Claude us role ki perspective, vocabulary aur priorities adopt karta hai. Ye isliye kaam karta hai kyunki LLM ne training me alag-alag roles ki language patterns seekhe hote hain. Best practice: role specific rakhein ('experienced grant writer' - sirf 'expert' nahi), aur role ke saath task bhi clear dein.
11Claude Artifacts kya hain aur kab use karein?
Artifacts Claude ka feature hai jo persistent content create aur edit karne deta hai - documents, code, ya creative writing - jo poori conversation me accessible rehta hai. Use karein jab content 20 lines se zyada ho, ya aapko iterative editing chahiye. Artifacts conversation se alag panel me dikhte hain, isliye long content chat me kho nahi jata. Pro tip: easy reference ke liye artifacts ko naam dein.
12Claude Projects kya hain aur ye Artifacts se kaise alag hain?
Projects ek workspace hain jahan aap related conversations aur files ko ek jagah organize karte hain, shared context ke saath. Artifacts ek single piece of content hain; Projects multiple conversations ka container hain. Important: Projects me context automatically share nahi hota - aapko manually files upload karni padti hain aur context set karna padta hai. Projects long-term kaam jaise research, book writing ya ongoing client work ke liye best hain.
13Extended Thinking kya hai?
Extended Thinking Claude ka feature hai jo complex problems ka deeper analysis allow karta hai - Claude answer dene se pehle zyada time sochta hai. Ye multi-step reasoning, complex analysis aur hard decisions ke liye useful hai. Trade-off: response time zyada lagta hai. Simple questions ke liye iski zaroorat nahi - use karein jab problem genuinely complex ho aur accuracy speed se zyada matter kare.
14Claude me file upload ki limits kya hain?
Kitab ke hisaab se (August 2025): ek file 30 MB se zyada nahi honi chahiye, aur ek baar me 20 se zyada files upload nahi kar sakte. Supported formats me PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, HTML, ODT, RTF, EPUB, JSON aur XLSX shamil hain. Images lagbhag 8000x8000 pixels tak process ho sakti hain. Scanned PDFs (image-only) pehle OCR se text searchable banane chahiye, warna Claude unhe padh nahi payega.
15Claude conversation me context kaise manage karein?
Lambi conversations me context window bhar jata hai aur Claude purani baatein bhool jata hai. Marathon strategy: (1) har milestone par key outputs ko artifact me save karein - save-as-you-go, (2) checkpoint method - conversation ka summary likhkar save karein, (3) refresh - summary ke saath nayi conversation shuru karein, (4) split - bade kaam ko chhote independent parts me todein. Ye Chapter 11 aur 16 ki core technique hai.
16CRAAP test kya hai aur research me iska kya use hai?
CRAAP test sources evaluate karne ka framework hai: Currency (kab publish hua), Relevance (aapke question se related hai?), Authority (lekhak ki credentials), Accuracy (information verify ho sakti hai?), Purpose (inform karna hai ya bechna?). Har criterion ko 1-5 rate karein; total /25 me 21+ strong source, 16-20 decent, 11-15 weak, 10 ya kam unreliable. Is SPA ka CRAAP Source Checker lab is test ko live practice karwata hai.
17Three-Source Rule kya hai?
Three-Source Rule kehta hai ki important claims ko kam se kam teen independent sources se verify karein. Ye isliye zaroori hai kyunki ek source galat ho sakta hai, biased ho sakta hai, ya doosre source ko copy kar raha ho sakta hai. Kitab ka example: ek claim ke liye teen sources me 13%, 22% aur 39% alag-alag numbers mile - tab pata chala ki 'average' ka matlab har source me alag tha. Research me ye rule hallucination aur misinformation se bachata hai.
18Claude se coding me kaise madad lein?
Claude coding me kai tareeke se madad karta hai: syntax aur concepts samjhana, code likhna aur debug karna, code review karna, aur nayi language seekhna. Best practice: (1) apna level aur context batayein, (2) chhote parts me kaam karein, (3) generated code ko hamesha run karke test karein - Claude ka code hamesha sahi nahi hota, (4) debugging me error message aur relevant code dono dein. Kitab ka password checker project iska complete example hai - Chapter 7 me full code ke saath.
19AI ethics kya hai aur Claude use karte waqt iska kya dhyaan rakhein?
AI ethics AI systems ke responsible use ke principles hain. Claude use karte waqt: (1) AI-generated kaam ko apna batakar submit na karein - credit dein jahan appropriate ho, (2) sensitive personal ya financial data share na karein, (3) critical decisions ke liye poori tarah AI par rely na karein, (4) biased outputs ko pehchanein aur challenge karein, (5) apni expertise aur judgment central rakhein. Kitab ka Golden Rule framework kehta hai: wo cheez mat karo jo aap nahi chahenge ki koi aur aapke saath kare.
20AI bias kya hai aur ise kaise pehchanein?
AI bias training data me maujood systematic prejudices hain jo outputs me aa jate hain - jaise gender, race ya age se judde stereotypes. Pehchanne ke red flags: ek group ke baare me baar-baar same stereotype, kisi perspective ka missing hona, ya language jo ek group ko dusre se kam capable dikhaye. Anti-bias toolkit: (1) alag-alag perspectives se same sawal poochhein, (2) outputs ko critically review karein, (3) Claude se explicitly kahein ki wo apne assumptions ko challenge kare, (4) important decisions me human review mandatory rakhein.
21Claude use karte waqt privacy ka kya dhyaan rakhein?
Privacy hierarchy yaad rakhein: kabhi share na karein - IDs, credit card numbers, passwords, medical records; soch-samajh kar share karein - proprietary data, unpublished work, confidential business information; safe hai - public information, generic questions, fictional scenarios. Ye hierarchy Chapter 17 me di gayi hai. Professional kaam me apne organization ki data policy check karein - kuch companies Claude jaise tools me confidential data daalne par rok lagati hain.
22Academic integrity aur AI - students ko kya dhyaan rakhna chahiye?
Academic integrity ka matlab hai apne kaam me imaandari. Claude ko learning enhance karne ke liye use karein, replace karne ke liye nahi. Appropriate: concepts samajhna, apne draft ko feedback ke liye dena, study guides banana. Inappropriate: assignments ko poora Claude se likhwakar apna naam lagana, exams me use karna, ya AI kaam ko bina disclosure ke submit karna. Har institution ki policy alag hoti hai - apne teacher ya institution ke rules pehle check karein.
23AI se jobs khatm ho jayengi ya naye jobs banenge?
Iska jawab uncertain hai aur technology se aage regulatory, economic aur social factors par depend karta hai. Bureau of Labor Statistics bhi is uncertainty ko acknowledge karta hai. Jo dikh raha hai: information processing wale roles transform ho rahe hain, jabki judgment, creativity aur human connection wale roles zyada valuable ho rahe hain. Career ladder web ban gayi hai - predictable path ki jagah adaptability aur continuous learning sabse important skills ban gaye hain. Kitab ke hisaab se skills jo endure kar sakte hain: ethical judgment, creative vision, emotional intelligence, strategic thinking aur behtar questions poochhna.
24Claude power user kaise banein?
Power user banna har feature jaanne ke baare me nahi hai - elegant simplicity ke saath extraordinary results achieve karne ke baare me hai. Kitab ke hisaab se isme typically 6-24 mahine ki sustained practice lagti hai. Path: (1) apni top 5 techniques document karein, (2) apna signature approach identify karein, (3) ek complex workflow document karein, (4) Claude ko dusre tools ke saath combine karke innovation karein, (5) community me knowledge share karein. Pitfalls se bachein: complexity addiction, guru complex aur tool obsession.
25Meta-prompting kya hai?
Meta-prompting ka matlab hai Claude se apne prompt ko hi improve karwana. Example: 'Ye mera current prompt hai: [prompt]. Is prompt ko improve karo: (1) kya ambiguous hai? (2) kaunsi constraints missing hain? (3) behtar version likho aur samjhao kyun behtar hai.' Ye prompt evolution engine ka hissa hai - aap prompt ko iterate karke behtar banate hain. Ye technique tab best hai jab aapko ek prompt baar-baar use karna ho, jaise templates ya recurring workflows me.
26Constraint engineering kya hai?
Constraint engineering me aap deliberately limitations lagakar creativity ko force karte hain - jaise 'sirf 100 words me samjhao' ya 'bina kisi technical term ke likho'. Kitab kehta hai: constraints creativity ko limit nahi karte, unlock karte hain. Ye technique brainstorming, creative writing aur problem-solving me kaam aati hai. Cascading constraints me aap ek ke baad ek constraint add karte hain aur har baar solution ko refine karte hain - ye recursive thinking ka practical application hai.
27Claude se data analysis kaise karein aur iski limits kya hain?
Claude se data analysis ka 4-step framework hai: data prepare karein, patterns ke liye AI suggestion lein, human statistical validation karein, phir findings communicate karein. Limits yaad rakhein: Claude patterns suggest karta hai, verify nahi karta - aapko statistics khud check karne hote hain. Sample sizes: trend ke liye 12-20 points, comparison ke liye 30 per group, correlation ke liye 50+, complex analysis ke liye 100+ chahiye. Small samples se conclusions nahi nikalne chahiye. Is SPA ka Data Pattern Finder lab ye concepts live dikhata hai.
28Business me Claude ka use kaise karein?
Business me Claude ke paanch main areas hain: document drafting, research support, analysis assistance, communication enhancement aur process optimization. Examples: Q3 sales data ka executive summary, market research synthesis, proposal drafts, meeting agendas. Professional standards: hamesha outputs verify karein, confidential data ki privacy ka dhyaan rakhein, aur compliance requirements (jaise GDPR) follow karein. Kitab ke success stories: ek accountant ne 3 ghante ka kaam 45 minute me kar liya; ek consultant ne Claude workflows se $10,000/month ki service banayi.
29GDPR aur AI compliance ka kya matlab hai?
GDPR European Union ka data protection regulation hai jo personal data ke use par rules lagata hai. AI tools use karte waqt iska matlab hai: personal data ko AI tools me daalne se pehle consent aur purpose check karein, data minimization follow karein (sirf zaroori data share karein), aur apne organization ki compliance policy follow karein. Alag countries ke alag rules hain - US me state-by-state laws hain, EU me AI Act hai. Business users ko apne legal team se confirm karna chahiye.
30Claude Pro plan aur free plan me kya farq hai?
Claude ke plans samay ke saath badalte rehte hain, isliye current pricing official website se check karein. Aam taur par farq hota hai: usage limits (free plan me kam messages), model access (paid plans me zyada capable models aur features jaise extended thinking), aur priority access. Is kitab ke time par Pro plan me zyada usage aur advanced features milte the. Interview me ye samajhna kaafi hai ki free vs paid ka farq usage limits aur features ka hota hai, capability ka nahi.
31Claude API aur Claude web app me kya farq hai?
Claude web app (claude.ai) end users ke liye hai - chat interface, Artifacts, Projects aur file upload ke saath. Claude API developers ke liye hai - apne apps aur workflows me Claude ko integrate karne ke liye, code ke through. API me aap tokens ke hisaab se pay karte hain aur programmatically control karte hain. Business users ke liye web app kaafi hai; developers ya automation ke liye API chahiye. Dono me same underlying models use hote hain.
32Claude ke models - Haiku, Sonnet, Opus - me kya farq hai?
Anthropic ke models capability aur speed ke spectrum par hote hain: Haiku sabse tez aur halka (quick tasks ke liye), Sonnet balanced (zyada tar kaam ke liye best), Opus sabse capable (complex reasoning aur hard problems ke liye). Model names aur lineup samay ke saath badalte rehte hain - is kitab me inka detail nahi hai, isliye current lineup official Anthropic website se check karein. Interview me ye samajhna kaafi hai ki model choice speed vs capability ka trade-off hoti hai.
33Claude se long-form writing (book, report) kaise karein?
Long-form writing ka process: (1) pehle outline banayein - structure Claude ke saath discuss karein, (2) ek chapter/section ek baar me likhein, (3) har section ke baad checkpoint save karein (artifact me), (4) voice preservation protocol use karein - apne writing samples dein taaki style consistent rahe, (5) three-pass editing karein - pehla pass structure, dusra clarity, teesra polish. Backward design technique: pehle final outcome define karein, phir peeche se plan banayein - jaise 80,000-word novel ke liye 250 words per weekday ka target.
34Claude ke answers inconsistent kyun hote hain aur ise kaise fix karein?
LLMs probabilistic hote hain - same prompt par bhi thode alag answers mil sakte hain, kyunki model har baar words ko probabilities ke basis par choose karta hai. Consistency ke liye anchor method use karein: pehli conversation ke successful outputs ko nayi conversation me paste karein aur explicitly kahein 'Is approach ko maintain karo'. Long-term ke liye Project ya Artifact me apna standard approach document karein. Important kaam me hamesha outputs ko verify karein aur key decisions khud lein.
35AI tools ke saath kaam karte waqt dependency se kaise bachein?
Dependency spectrum yaad rakhein: AI ko assistant ki tarah use karna healthy hai, lekin har kaam ke liye us par depend hona risky hai. 80/20 rule: 80% kaam aapki expertise se, 20% AI assistance se - ya ulta bhi ho sakta hai, lekin aapko bina AI ke bhi kaam karne ki ability banaye rakhni chahiye. Apni skills practice karte rahein, AI outputs ko blindly accept na karein, aur critical thinking ko hamesha active rakhein. Kitab kehta hai: AI aapki expertise amplify kare, replace na kare.
36Claude ke future updates ke saath kaise updated rahein?
Kitab ka Chapter 18 ka system: weekly check-in (har Friday 5 minute - official announcements dekhein), monthly deep dive (ek naya feature try karein), aur curated information diet (ek quality newsletter + official channels, social media noise nahi). Beta-testing decision framework: naye features ko pehle low-risk kaam par try karein, phir important workflows me adopt karein. Roadmap par poori tarah bharosa na karein - AI development timelines unpredictable hote hain.
Source:Mastering Claude AI (Apress, 2025) — FAQs is kitab ke concepts par based hain.

Trust Check

Jo genuinely out of scope hai (imaandaari se)

  • Index (p. 373): kitab ka alphabetical index alag section nahi hai — har topic apne chapter ke section me cover hai, index se search karne ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Cover image aur author/reviewer photos: cover aur author ki photos embed nahi ki gayi hain — unme vyakti ki pehchan (naam/chehra) hoti hai.
  • Chhote decorative icons: kitab ke ~50px ke chhote icons (kuch headings ke saath) embed nahi kiye gaye — wo decoration hain, content nahi.
  • Kuch diagrams me garbled words: kuch figures ke pixels me kuch words garbled hain (jaise Fig 3-1 ke kuch labels) — legible hissa transcribe kiya gaya hai, garbled words guess karke nahi likhe gaye.
  • Chapter 13 ka summary: kitab me Chapter 13 ka chapter summary sirf ~6 lines ka hai — is SPA me usi summary ke basis par section banaya gaya hai, usse zyada content invent nahi kiya gaya.
  • Model names, pricing aur feature limits: Claude ke model names (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus), plans aur file limits samay ke saath badalte rehte hain — kitab ke time ke figures diye gaye hain; current details official website se check karein.
  • Appendix B ke full resource lists: Appendix B ki lambi resource lists (communities, courses, books) ka essence diya gaya hai — har ek link word-for-word copy nahi kiya gaya, kyunki wo lists hain, content nahi.
Source:Mastering Claude AI (Apress, 2025) — Trust Check is page ke live DOM se counts ginata hai.
